comments.value: I like the sound effect now, so please make it possible to adjust the volume.

Until now, people didn't say "I love it" or "I hate it" as much as they do now, and they didn't "pay attention" to the sound of the shutter in the first place. It was "zero". (Neutral, too.)
When sound accompanies frequent and very everyday behaviors, it should be as "zero" as possible.
There is no need to try to promote or inhibit those behaviors; they should only play a minimal role.
There is no need to insist on their existence to people.
In that respect, the previous sound was appropriate.

@{5b83e4ecbf31801631aa98b6|full_name}: Now that the comparison has been made, it's natural to like or dislike it.
I don't think the old sound is adequate. I don't think the old sound is appropriate, because the current sound is more camera-like.
比較対象が出来たんだから好き嫌いが出るのは自然でしょう。
以前の音が適切かというと、わたしはそう思いません。今の音の方がよりカメラらしい音なので。
With a previous update, the shutter sound volume was adjusted.

details:
Be quieter the camera shutter sound.
The current (RELEASE 2020.3.2) shutter sound seems much more assertive than before.
Also, the only thing that changes in the Audio Volume UI/Menu is its own camera sound.
Even if you find the shutter sound unpleasant, the sound emitted by others is not adjustable.
Importantly, if you're uncomfortable with the sound, taking the picture itself is no longer a pleasant experience.
Especially for places that enjoy music, it's "fatal".
Until now, this issue didn't really bother me, but it became especially noticeable after RELEASE 2020.3.2 changed the shutter sound to a more assertive one.
I've also posted about that in the RELEASE 2020.3.2 column.
https://vrchat.canny.io/release-202032/p/be-quieter-the-camera-shutter-sound
Here are two solutions.
**1. Make the shutter sound less assertive.**
- You can achieve this by reverting to the previous sound.
**2. Make the shutter volume adjustable.**
- Use [AudioVolume UI/Menu] to adjust other people's shutter sounds
If either 1 or 2 are implemented, I think this will be resolved.
Most desirable is that both 1 and 2 are implemented.
---
[Japanese]
カメラのシャッター音を静かにする。
現在(RELEASE 2020.3.2)のシャッター音は、以前に比べてかなり主張の強いものに感じます。
また、Audio VolumeのUI/Menuで変化するのは自分のカメラ音だけです。
シャッター音が不快に感じる場合でも、他人から発せられる音は調整不可能です。
重要なのは、音に対して不快感があると、写真を撮ることそのものが心地良いものではなくなってしまうということです。
特に音楽を楽しむ場所にとっては「致命的」です。
今まではこの問題は特に気になりませんでしたが、RELEASE 2020.3.2でシャッター音が主張の強いものに変更されてから特に顕著になりました。
その件については、RELEASE 2020.3.2の欄にもポストしています。
https://vrchat.canny.io/release-202032/p/be-quieter-the-camera-shutter-sound
解決方法を2つ挙げます。
**1. シャッター音を主張の少ない音にする。**
- 以前の音に戻すことで実現できます。
**2. Make the shutter volume adjustable.**
- Audio VolumeのUI/Menuで、他人のシャッター音も調整されるようにする
1か2のどちらかが実装されれば解決されると思います。
最も望ましいのは1と2のどちらも実装されることです。
title: Be quieter the camera shutter sound.
